purpose: Offline optimistic post-contact motor-authority diagnostic, NOT a proposed controller or added deployment sensing
scope: Frozen R34 source/world/initial state and original .2mm criterion. Three .08s probes at1.5625us. The diagnostic normal/Jacobian oracle is privileged and is never supplied to ESN or a full task. No pre-contact action. Instant mode intentionally violates slew solely to inspect a mechanical time-scale hypothesis.
claims_limit: A greedy local diagnostic is not a global optimal-control bound; no short probe counts as task or ESN success.
